Retain the strong cyan light spilling from the left-of-center doorway, magenta reflected wash on the left wall and near-black right wall. Preserve the doorway, ceiling, panel geometry, visible stairs, and sparse empty composition from this ONE reference. Adapt only the outer framing to a clean wide combat background, keeping the lower quarter clear and continuous for two fighters; do not add extra rooms or architecture. The front panel has just two blank muted-purple rectangular paper-like patches: one small nearly horizontal patch high at right, one larger tilted rectangular patch low at left. The left side has two similar blank purple patches, a small one high and a larger tilted one lower. Preserve the angular frame, dark indigo shading, reddish violet edge highlights, and the relationship of the top, front and left planes from the source. There are NO printed symbols or words on the patches. Isolate only this upper small cube; omit the larger box beneath it and every backdrop element. Do not add handles, hinges, rivets, wheels, feet, locks, metallic corners, stickers with text, gems or emblems. A single full cube silhouette, fully inside the image with at least ten percent transparent breathing room on all four sides; centered, no crop. Clean hand-drawn 2D television-animation linework and restrained cel shading, not photorealistic or 3D. No floor, cast shadow, room, characters, particles, typography, watermark, checkerboard, collage or extra object. True native alpha outside the case.
